name: Salang Tunnel
scope: Whole Salang Tunnel in a coherent approximate 2011 appearance: complete named main bore and both intrinsic northern and southern avalanche galleries along all original mapped centerline controls; both tunnel ends, continuous road floor, lining/roof, concrete gallery roof/walls/open bays and structural supports, portal piers/beams and short retaining returns. Do not substitute one photographed portal for the full tunnel. Native current centerlines register the older structure approximately; precise historic gallery extents, profiles, grade, bay census and unseen southern portal details are estimated. Exclude the wider pass highway, unrelated culverts, natural mountain body, vehicles, soldiers, snow, signage and later 2013/2023 reconstruction finishes.

originalReview.notes: Personally inspected exact published 1000px rendition, not described as native original. Primary DVIDS photo ID, Army VIRIN, named uniformed photographer, official Army unit, offered rendition URL and explicit PUBLIC DOMAIN notice bound. Actual beamed concrete portal with tall flanking piers, opening, horizontal relief courses and short retaining wings; 2011 convoy views corroborate the portal mass. Trucks/soldiers/snow/banner/markings excluded. These photographs do not survey the hidden bore or every gallery bay; those derive from native centerlines and primary engineering text with explicit section/census estimates.

review.method: Published Qualla corpus screened first. Generic Army.mil credit, unrelated regional sources and attribution-only photos excluded. Four exact named Army DVIDS public-domain published renditions inspected; primary engineering text and complete native centerlines supply whole structure scope. Hidden sections, historic alignment and unphotographed bays explicitly estimated; no requirement for a photograph of every bay.
